description: Audits an EXISTING blog article's statistics, re-researches its keyword with the current research steps, and proposes targeted edits with a before/after scorecard. It does not rewrite the article. What it checks per stat: is the number on the cited page, does the source label match the URL, is there a year, is it a real finding (not a study size or a date), and does the cited page itself credit another source. Edits only replace/remove failed stats, fix labels and years, cite primaries, reword unreplicated claims honestly, and may add one short analysis callout from measured SERP data. Every number in an edit must already be in the original paragraph or in the verified research; others are rejected. It also reads the page's synced search performance and the brand audience, classifies the queries bringing people to the page as ICP buyer / ICP research / off-ICP, and returns a verdict: enrich (mostly ICP intent), reframe (adjacent topic, wrong angle: bigger edits aimed at the ICP) or retire (mostly off-ICP, no realistic angle: a recommendation to unpublish with a 301 or 410, never applied). Search numbers are used only for analysis and never written into the article. Optional `angle` (short target direction) steers the research and the rewrite; optional `instructions` steer the edit (tone, product pages, must-cover points); `verdict` overrides the computed one. The run also researches each H2 section, upgrades secondary stats to their primary page, and mines the searched sources, so the rewrite adds new verified stats and sources (see `enrichment` in the result). DRY RUN by default (apply=false): changes nothing and returns the proposal. Set apply=true only after the user has reviewed a dry run; it then overwrites the article body in place (no version history). Async — returns `{ operationId, status }`. Poll get_job(operationId) until state is 'completed'; the job `result` holds `icp` (verdict, rationale, impression shares by class), `performance` (baseline + diagnoses), `suggestions` (title / meta description, never applied), `edits` (blockId, before, after, reason), `rejectedEdits`, `scorecard.before/after`, `enrichedMarkdown`, `research`, `skipped`, `costUsd`, and (when apply=true) `applied`/`appliedEdits`/`unappliedEdits`. Typically a few minutes.

angle.description: Short target direction (e.g. 'free SEO tools for SaaS founders instead of cracked software'). Steers the research (per-section queries) and the rewrite; with no verdict given it defaults to reframe.

apply.description: false (default) = dry run, returns the proposal only. true = also write the accepted edits into the article body.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

instructions.description: Free-text editorial direction for the rewrite (angle, tone, which product pages to point to). Highest priority; also an allowed source of product numbers and links.

keyword.description: Keyword to re-research. Defaults to the article's primary keyword, else its title.

verdict.description: Override the computed ICP verdict. Omit to let the article's search-query mix decide (enrich / reframe / retire).

voiceId.description: Saved voice profile id (list_voices). After the edits are final, the edited paragraphs are rewritten in this voice; numbers, links and unsupported claims the voice changes are reverted per block, and invented first-person anecdotes are stripped.

name: enrich_blog_article
